entry.headline: Extended — wait for a pullback
entry.headline_zh: 过度拉伸 — 等待回撤
entry.action: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended (momentum is fading — the daily momentum is already rolling over). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.action_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸（动量正在衰竭——日线动量已开始掉头向下）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

profile.archetype_why: high beta & high volatility vs peers
profile.archetype_why_zh: 相对同业高贝塔、高波动
profile.description: Arlo Technologies is an American company that makes wireless surveillance cameras. Prior to an initial public offering (IPO) on the New York Stock Exchange in August 2018, Arlo was a brand of such products by Netgear, which retained majority control after the IPO.
profile.description_zh: Arlo Technologies是一家制造无线监控摄像头的美国公司。在2018年8月于纽约证券交易所首次公开募股（IPO）之前，Arlo曾是网件公司（Netgear）旗下的此类产品品牌，IPO后网件仍保留多数控股权。

macro.headline_en: Rate risk runs through its market / growth beta, not a distinct duration leg.
macro.headline_zh: 其利率风险通过市场／成长beta体现，并无独立的久期暴露。
